title: crow mission kind
description: One file per kind (kinds/<name>.yaml). core reads it; a new kind needs no engine change. Scope-dependent values sit under by_scope and override the top-level ones.

phase.description: Roadmap phase that enables the kind (1 = 0.3b, 2 = J1, 3 = J2 after the sandbox).

purpose.description: One sentence shown on the New mission sheet.

absorbs.description: Earlier kind names that map to this one.

name.description: Skill the run invokes; null while no skill exists (the brief then carries the instructions).

mode.description: Argument passed to the skill (for example self or peer).

fallbacks.description: Other skills the run may call.

status.description: exists = tracked in this repo; local = private copy in local/; bundled = shipped by logics-manager; missing = to write.

pattern.description: Regex the key must match; the mission id is YYYYMMDD-<kind>-<key slug>.

route.description: scope = the scope-aware pick (per-scope ranks from the private accounts file); any-allowed = any allowed account with room. Account names never appear in a kind file.

overflow.description: Where the router may overflow; work data never leaves Claude.

resumes.description: Resumes in a row before core asks the owner.

rounds.description: Owner rounds (change or msg) before core asks to extend or abandon.

worktree.description: True when the run works in its own worktree under <repo>.wt/.

outputs.description: Files the run must leave in the mission dir (relative paths, vN = version).

needs_validation.description: True when core refuses to publish without a valid validation record.

ask_actions.description: Actions that still need an ok on the exact text when needs_validation is false (public posts).

preflight.description: Questions asked before dispatch. Skipped questions take their safest default, which the run states in its plan or report.

safest.description: Value used when the owner skips the question.

sensitive_paths_ask.description: Changes under CI, sandbox, units or policy paths always ask, whatever the gates.

gates.description: Ordered gate steps. [] = straight through, [report] = report gate, [plan] = plan gate, [plan, report] = two-gate, [mockup] = mockup loop.
